subject: Lumina Health — deployment readiness and kickoff prep
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lumina Health — pre-handoff: deployment readiness + constraints

Team — forwarding the final commercial thread and SOW for Lumina Health. High-level summary and asks below so CS can pick up the activation plan. Attachment: lumina_sow_v3.pdf (pdf)

Deal context
- Account: Lumina Health (virtual care platform for payor/ provider customers)
- Term: 12 months, committed Dedicated capacity (8x A100-equivalent GPUs, baseline throughput 120 RPS for short-chat model)
- Start target: week of Apr 11 (preferred) — commercial close in DocuSign pending procurement signoff

Committed deliverables (what sales promised)
- Dedicated inference pool with VPC peering and private endpoint for API traffic
- SOC2 evidence provided and quarterly security reviews
- 2-day technical onboarding + 4-week implementation sprint (SOW lists milestones)

Technical constraints / notes
- Network: Lumina requires private peering and a static egress range. See network_requirements.xlsx attached.
- Data: No persistent storage of PII on Redwood logs; customer will provide logs to our S3 for debugging under encryption-at-rest.
- Model: We'll be serving a quantized Llama-derived candidate; latency SLO 95th <= 120ms for 2k context.
- Rate limiting: they expect burst capacity for three spikes per month — agreed to two scheduled bursts (up to 2x baseline) included in the reserved pool.

People and next steps
- Primary CS owner (ask): assign primary CSM and technical lead.
- Proposed kickoff: Apr 12 or Apr 13 (they prefer mornings PST).
- Procurement: markup requested on legal — will share DocuSign link when ready.

Action items for CS (please confirm owners):
1) Confirm primary CSM and Implementation Engineer.
2) Review network_requirements.xlsx and validate peering/mutual auth gaps by EOD Mon.
3) Confirm kickoff time availability next week to share calendar invite with Lumina stakeholders.

Notes for CS handoff call: bring answers on staging environment access, test corpus transfer, and rollback policy for model pinning.

Thanks — I can join the initial kickoff for context if helpful.

--
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumina Health — pre-handoff: deployment readiness + constraints

Markus — thanks for the concise summary. I'll take primary CSM ownership for this deal.

Prelim assignments
- Primary CSM: Priyom Das (I'll run the activation)
- Implementation Lead: Naomi Feldman (technical lead / infra contact)
- Onboarding Engineer: Grace O'Connor (integration and scripts)

Quick clarifying Qs before we schedule kickoff:
- Does Lumina require customer-managed VPN termination, or can we do VPC peering on their side? Network sheet references static egress but not termination model.
- Can you confirm the model family (exact HF model name) and whether they expect us to retain a KV-cache snapshot between sessions?

I'll review the SOW and network sheet this afternoon. Naomi — once you validate the peering options, we'll propose two kickoff slots on Apr 12 (09:30–10:30 PDT) and Apr 13 (10:00–11:00 PDT).

I will also prepare a brief runbook for the kickoff: agenda + acceptance criteria + 30/60/90-day milestones.

- Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Customer Success Manager
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: Hector Ruiz <hector.ruiz@luminahealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumina Procurement <procurement@luminahealth.com>, Aisha Coleman <aisha.coleman@luminahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumina Health — pre-handoff: deployment readiness + constraints

Thanks Markus / Priyom — appreciate the summary. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Procurement has one redline on the termination clause; procurement@luminahealth.com is on cc and will send the minor redline today.
2) SOC2: we need the latest SOC2 Type II report and a point of contact for periodic evidence requests.
3) Network: Lumina prefers customer-managed VPN termination into our VPC (we control the termination appliance). Can your team confirm if that's supported and whether we will need inbound firewall rules configurable on your side?
4) Kickoff availability: Apr 12 (09:30–10:30 PDT) looks good for our PMs. We'd like to add our Security Architect (Aisha) for the first 20 minutes.

We're ok to sign once procurement completes the redline acceptance; can you share DocuSign when available? Also saw the SOW draft — thanks.

For SOC2 and evidence collection, please send the report to procurement@luminahealth.com and cc me.

Best,
Hector Ruiz
Head of Platform Engineering | Lumina Health
hector.ruiz@luminahealth.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Hector Ruiz <hector.ruiz@luminahealth.com>, Lumina Procurement <procurement@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumina Health — pre-handoff: deployment readiness + constraints

Hector / team — great, thanks for the quick responses. Responses and next steps below. Attachment: docusign_sow_lumina_20270329.link (DocuSign link)

1) Procurement redline
- Markus (legal) has reviewed the procurement comment and agreed to the minor termination language update. I have asked Legal to accept and they will complete the DocuSign flow today. Link: https://www.docusign.com/link/sow-lumina-20270329

2) SOC2 evidence
- Naomi: attaching the latest SOC2 Type II summary and point-of-contact details to the procurement thread. (Attachment: lumina_sow_v3.pdf includes the evidence appendix.)

3) Network termination
- We support customer-managed VPN termination into a dedicated subnet. Naomi, Grace: please own the port and static egress range mapping with Lumina's network team; procurement needs the firewall rules list documented.

4) Kickoff scheduling
- Confirmed: Apr 12, 09:30–10:30 PDT. We'll send a Calendar invite with a proposed agenda and pre-kickoff checklist. Aisha — we'll reserve first 20 minutes for security architecture discussion.

Naomi / Grace — can you confirm the peering checklist by EOD Wed (Mar 31)? Priyom — I'll join the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

--
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
